paite: "Pathian aw, nang na hon khahkhia a, na hon hihsia a; na hong hehta a; hon tungding nawn in aw.
heading: David La / Suahtakna Dia Thumna Aram Naharaim Leh Aram Zobah Toh Akidou Lai Ua, Joab In Ahong Kik Nawn Lam A Chikhuk Phaizang A Edom Mi Singkhat-le-sangnih Athah Lai A

paite: Hiai gam na hihling a, na khangsakta hi; akhangkhamte siam hoih nawn inla; aling aling ngal a.
Na mite thil haksa pipi na tuaksak a hoina uain na hon dawnsak hi.
Nang laudan siamte kiang ah puanzak na peta a, thutak ziak a zak ahihtheihna ding in. Selah
Na deihtakte humbit a a-om theihna ding un, na khut taklam in hon hondam inla, hon dawng in.
"Pathian in asianthouna ah hichibang in agen, ka nuam ding a; Shekem khua ka hawm ding a, Sukkoth phaizang ka hawmzak ding hi.
Gilead gam kei a ahi a, Manasseh gam kei a ahi a; Ephraim gam leng ka lu humbitna ahi a; Judah gam ka lalchiang ahi.
Moab gam ka kisilna bel ahi; Edom gam ah khedap ka pai ding, Philistia gam, nang zaw keimah ziak in kikou tanla, chi in.
"Khopi kiptak ah kua'n ahon pilut dia! Edom gam ah kua'n a hon pi ding!
Pathian aw, nangmah mah in na hon deih louh ka hi kei ua hia? Pathian aw, ka sepaihte kiang uah lah na pawt ngal ta kei a.
Melmate sual ding in hon panpih in, mihing panpihna bangmah lou maimai ahi ngal a.
Pathian ziak in hangsantak in ka hih ding; amah tuh i melmate sikden dingpa ahi ngal a."
